summary: The diff implements most of the required admin panel password protection and session lock features. REQ-1, REQ-2, and REQ-3 appear well-implemented. REQ-4 is partially implemented — /admin/qr route is missing from the router configuration, while /admin, /admin/dashboard, /admin/billing, and /admin/settings are all wrapped with AdminGuard. Additionally, the AdminGuard still shows a loading spinner briefly before redirecting rather than a true synchronous redirect, which is a minor AC concern for REQ-1.

missing_requirements.requirement: Wrap ALL admin routes including /admin/qr with AdminGuard so none are publicly accessible.
missing_requirements.reason: The App.tsx route tree does not include an /admin/qr route at all — neither guarded nor unguarded. The spec explicitly names /admin/qr as a required route that must be wrapped with AdminGuard.

missing_requirements.requirement: Synchronously check for a valid admin session before rendering any admin content — no content should flash before redirect.
missing_requirements.reason: AdminGuard renders a loading spinner before the useEffect redirect fires. The redirect is asynchronous via useEffect rather than truly synchronous, meaning interim UI is shown before navigation occurs.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin ID field on the login page requiring a two-credential login flow with both Admin ID and Password.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only specifies a hardcoded password check. It does not mention an Admin ID field or a two-credential login. The AdminLoginPage introduces a separate ADMIN_ID credential that was never requested.

hallucinated_features.description: /admin/dashboard route added as a separate guarded route alias for AdminPage.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request lists /admin, /admin/settings, /admin/qr, and /admin/billing as the admin routes. An /admin/dashboard route was not requested.
